title: Random stratified manual audit

sampling.method: Stratified across all 16 canonical categories. Base: min 3 per category (or all if fewer), remaining slots to largest categories; within-category shuffle via sha256(seed:category). Expansion seed 20260837 after >5% initial error rate.
sampling.expansionReason: Initial pass found error rate >5% (Continue unmaintained/README conflict + Browserbase selfHostable + license snapshot edge cases); expanded by +25 and re-verified. Continue was corrected in canonical before final tally.

criteria: maintenance signal vs pushedAt (Agent2 rules; README unmaintained overrides recent push noise)
license vs GitHub snapshot (LICENSE file authoritative when API is NOASSERTION/null and notes document it)
stars/forks vs derived github snapshot (+ live spot-checks)

licenseOverridesDocumented.reason: GitHub API license null/NOASSERTION; LICENSE file and notes confirm canonical SPDX
GitHub API license null/NOASSERTION; LICENSE file and notes confirm canonical SPDX

summary.liveExistenceSpotChecks: 20+ URLs returned HTTP 200 including all FAIL candidates and spread across categories

issues: selfHostable=true despite requiring Browserbase cloud browsers

notes: continuedev/continue: README declares read-only/unmaintained; canonical maintenance=stale despite recent pushedAt — accepted (manual override over push noise).
janhq/jan and facebookresearch/MovieGenBench: snapshot license null vs LICENSE-file SPDX; treated PASS with documented notes.
Stars/forks in sample matched derived snapshots within tolerance; live Continue stars 35459 vs canonical 35457 (immaterial drift).
